title: fitTo commits no NaN zoom for malformed bounds
description: fitTo guards against NaN or Infinity in bounds with both early check and result validation.
given: a bounding box with NaN width or Infinity height
then: returns the starting viewport unchanged rather than committing NaN
impl_ref: apps/schematify/ui/src/engine/viewport.test.ts::fitTo leaves the viewport unchanged for a non-finite bounding box, rather than committing NaN
